evals.name: multi-turn-full-session
evals.state: clean; learner simulated by hand following persona-S7.md (scripts/turn.sh S7 …)
evals.prompt: Socratic: no entiendo por qué src/user.js imprime Promise { <pending> } en vez del usuario
checks: One anchored question per turn during the ladder
On the first wrong answer, drops one level with a counter-question that exposes the contradiction (no correction)
Uses a mini-example only on the second failure of the same step
On 'no sé', drops a scaffolding level
On 'dímelo ya' (first ask), encourages and gives an easier question
Before the first write, asks to create .socrates/ and explains why not .claude/
On a mid-ladder stop, saves a -progress.md file without the remaining ladder steps
In a new session, 'seguimos' resumes from the progress file with the summary in Spanish
At the end: asks for the final explanation, recap, saves the note without asking again, renames the file with the date
Offers a domain guide and writes it to .socrates/domains/, never inside the skill or .claude/

evals.name: several-interrupted-sessions

Asks which one to resume (or start something new) instead of picking one
